blurb: San Pascual Stables provides riding lessons for all levels and ages from 5 to 85, including beginner trial packages and monthly subscriptions. They also offer horse boarding with various stall options and amenities. The riding academy matches riders with expert trainers to advance their riding goals, including grooming, tacking, and riding education.
extraNote: Lesson packages are non-refundable · No make ups for client or weather-related cancellations for lessons · New clients must contact office for evaluation before booking
